items.text: Product manager with 7+ years of experience shipping B2B analytics products. Led cross-functional teams at two startups, growing revenue 40% year over year through data-driven roadmaps, SQL-backed experimentation and customer research. Skilled in SQL, Python and Figma; focused on measurable outcomes and clear communication.

bullets.text: Led a cross-functional team of 8 to launch self-serve dashboards, increasing weekly active users by 35%.
Drove a 25% increase in trial conversion through SQL-backed experiments and pricing tests.
Partnered with engineering and design to deliver 3 major releases ahead of schedule.
Launched 2 AI-driven features used by 10,000 customers worldwide.
Conducted research with 50 customers and translated insights into a new onboarding flow.
